title: Selûnite Prayer Sheet
summary: Read beside the Owlbear Nest’s protected chest to unlock it.

fields.Use: Read the prayer near the Gilded Chest using a party member other than Shadowheart. Any Acolyte, including Shadowheart, can earn Her Gift of Silver by reading.
fields.Acquisition: Jump behind the Selûne statue at X −325, Y −145. DC 10 Perception reveals the sheet, and DC 15 Religion identifies the contents.
fields.Base value: 14 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
